format:
<template>
    <iframe
        ref="mapFrame"
        src="/worldmap"
        style="width: 100%; height: 480px; border: none; border-radius: 8px;"
        @load="applyArrowOffset">
    </iframe>
</template>

<script>
export default {
    mounted() {
        this.applyArrowOffset();
        this._styleTimer = setInterval(() => this.applyArrowOffset(), 500);
    },
    beforeUnmount() {
        if (this._styleTimer) clearInterval(this._styleTimer);
    },
    methods: {
        applyArrowOffset() {
            const doc = this.$refs.mapFrame?.contentDocument;
            if (!doc || !doc.head) return;

            let style = doc.getElementById('arrow-offset-style');
            if (!style) {
                style = doc.createElement('style');
                style.id = 'arrow-offset-style';
                doc.head.appendChild(style);
            }
            style.textContent = `
                .leaflet-marker-icon:not(.awesome-marker) {
                    top: 38px !important;
                }
            `;
        }
    }
}
</script>
